verdict.rationale: Postman's docs describe a Fabric Gateway that lets users register external MCP servers and make them available to their team (postman-docs-7), and separately an MCP Generator to create MCP servers from APIs (postman-docs-9), showing Postman does integrate with the MCP ecosystem. However, the evidence doesn't clearly confirm that Postman's own AI/Agent Mode consumes tools from these registered MCP servers to act on them, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Agent Mode calls tools from user-added MCP servers, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
